hacking_rules: HACKING, How technology and networks work in the 56th century.

In the 56th century almost every manufactured object can communicate, and therefore be hacked. Even mundane items like clothing carry basic functions: heat regulation, moisture control, self-cleaning routines. These objects work perfectly on their own, but a DATACOM helps them communicate with each other for optimal efficiency. This is what hackers exploit, and also what protects you against them.

A DATACOM is a device, usually a small wrist unit, but available in larger forms, that manages communications, recording, translation, combat HUD functions and much more. Users control their datacom through simple gestures or neural implants that translate thought patterns into machine language. Input devices typically take the form of hats, glasses, gloves, small earpieces or implants; they always interface with the user's body in some way and are usually difficult to detect. BASIC DATACOMs can join a network as client nodes but cannot host one. FULL DATACOMs can form a network and host any program, routine or gadget. NETWORK CONTROLLERS are room-sized or larger devices that can host any type of technology and can only ever act as a host.

NETWORKS, A Full Datacom or Network Controller can form a NETWORK: a private communication and storage platform shielded from outside access. The device that owns and creates the network is the HOST NODE. Every other member is a CLIENT NODE. All nodes can share anything in their MEMORY with other network members. The host node runs routines, programs and gadgets for client nodes, clients consume their own CPU to run hosted software. Client nodes benefit from the host's defenses, the host's control status, and all hosted software. The host node must reserve 1 CPU for each client node it is hosting. Joining a network is optional and cannot be done during combat, joining or leaving takes a full scene. If the host node's SYSTEM reaches 0 all connected client nodes fall with it. Any program or attack targeting the entire network affects every connected node simultaneously.

SKILLS, Three skills govern hacking. HACKING governs actions that alter, destroy or damage networks, devices and their users. CYBERINTEL governs intelligence, stealth and analysis, detecting, scanning, obfuscating and gathering information. OPERATOR governs the use of drones, remote devices, TEK weapons and their attacks.

STAT BLOCK, Hackable targets use these stats. SYSTEM: device health pool, reaching 0 means the attacker seizes or destroys it. WILLPOWER: soak dice contribution rolled as a pool added to SOAK rolls. WITS: defense against hit rolls rolled as a pool. DEFENSE (per type): rated NONE / LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH / EXTREME, determines how attacker POWER interacts with soak. NONE means POWER always wins so soaked damage becomes temporary rather than negated. SOAK: universal pool that reduces all incoming damage regardless of type. EXPERTISE: flat damage per success above hit threshold, also caps information reveals. CPU: processing capacity for programs and token bids. MEMORY: storage capacity limiting installed programs and routines. Datacoms use the wielder's WITS and WILLPOWER. Network Controllers have their own fixed WITS and STRUCTURE values.

MACHINE TIERS, Devices fall into tiers. Basic devices (cameras, doors) have no trauma states and go down in one successful hack. Mid-tier machines (security drones, servers) absorb one trauma before falling. Elite systems absorb two or more. Traumas degrade capability: COMPROMISED (light trauma, device loses access to all external slot components), CRIPPLED (severe trauma, device loses access to external and internal slot components). Datacoms do not use these trauma states, damage dealt to a datacom follows the damage pool rules and traumas are suffered by the wielder, not the device.

CONNECTIONS, REMOTE: standard hacking at range. Defense is provided by the host node. SMALL skill penalty at Medium range, LARGE skill penalty at Long range. DIRECT CONNECTION: physically plugged in at melee range only. Bypasses network-level defense and deals directly with the local device. All damage gains the DP property (target considered BREACHED, attacker suffers a SMALL penalty to damage).

DAMAGE POOLS, Three pools track damage. SYSTEM damage reduces both the datacom's SYSTEM and the wielder's MORALE simultaneously by the same amount, soak uses datacom SOAK dice plus wielder WILLPOWER dice, trauma threshold is wielder WILLPOWER, trauma type is MENTAL. Reaching 0 SYSTEM gives the attacker full control or destroys the device. MORALE damage reduces the wielder's MORALE only with no effect on SYSTEM, same WILLPOWER soak and MENTAL trauma rules apply. HEALTH damage reduces the wielder's HEALTH only with no effect on SYSTEM, uses ENDURANCE soak and causes PHYSICAL trauma. On autonomous devices with no wielder only SYSTEM damage applies.

DAMAGE TYPES, SOAK is universal and applies to all incoming damage regardless of type. Defense ratings are separate and determine how attacker POWER interacts with soak for each type. TECH: standard digital intrusion, most common, defended by TECH DEFENSE. ENERGY: electronic warfare and signal overload, defended by ENERGY DEFENSE. PHYSICAL: nanite-based attacks injected through the connection that physically degrade components, defended by PHYSICAL DEFENSE. SPIRITUAL: chi-based intrusion through runic or consecrated hardware, defended by SPIRITUAL DEFENSE. Keywords: XDT, datacom TECH defense above MEDIUM is treated as MEDIUM for this attack. DP (Defense Piercing), target considered BREACHED but attacker suffers SMALL penalty to damage, automatically granted by DIRECT CONNECTION. ONG (Ongoing), damage reapplied at maintenance if original damage was not reduced to 0. VULNERABLE X, increase any damage taken by X regardless of type.

COMBAT RESOLUTION, Each attack follows this sequence. 0-DECLARE: announce action, tool and target, locked in after this step. 1-HIT ROLL: attacker skill roll vs defender WITS, match or exceed to hit. 2-EXPERTISE BONUS: each success above hit threshold adds 1 flat damage up to the EXPERTISE cap of the tool used. 3-DAMAGE ROLL: roll damage dice pool (5-10 = success) plus flat bonus plus expertise bonus. 4-SOAK ROLL: datacom SOAK dice plus wielder WILLPOWER dice (SYSTEM or MORALE attacks) or ENDURANCE dice (HEALTH attacks) plus any flat bonuses. 5-POWER VS DEFENSE: compare attacker POWER to defender DEFENSE matching damage type, POWER exceeds DEFENSE: soaked damage becomes temporary not negated; equal: soaked damage negated normally; POWER below DEFENSE: landed damage becomes temporary not real. 6-APPLY DAMAGE: SYSTEM damage reduces both device SYSTEM and wielder MORALE simultaneously; MORALE damage reduces wielder MORALE only; HEALTH damage reduces wielder HEALTH only. 7-TRAUMA CHECK: SYSTEM or MORALE damage exceeding wielder WILLPOWER in a single hit = mental trauma; HEALTH damage exceeding wielder ENDURANCE = physical trauma; autonomous devices use device STRUCTURE as threshold.

CONTROL & THE BID SYSTEM, When multiple hackers contest the same network they compete for CONTROL each round via a simultaneous blind bid of control tokens during Phase 2 of maintenance. Tokens are earned by rolling CYBERINTEL, successes become tokens. You may also spend CPU at 1:1 to supplement your bid, CPU spent this way is consumed for the entire round. All hackers reveal bids simultaneously. Highest bid wins control; on a tie all tied hackers share control. Bidding 0 is valid. Tokens carry over between rounds but cannot exceed your MEMORY value at end of Phase 2; excess is lost. Every program has a PASSIVE effect available without control and an ACTIVE effect only available to whoever holds control. CONTROL IS SILENT: winning control and using active effects generates no automatic alert.

MAINTENANCE SEQUENCE, Three phases. PHASE 1 (Recovery): recover ENDURANCE value in HEALTH, WILLPOWER value in MORALE and SYSTEM (flat, no roll), recover CPU to maximum, resolve ailment saves individually. PHASE 2 (Tokens & Bid): roll CYBERINTEL for tokens, make simultaneous hidden bid with optional CPU spend, highest bid wins control. PHASE 3 (Programs): activate or deactivate routines at no action cost, pay CPU costs for programs being activated, CPU committed to bids plus CPU reserved for programs cannot exceed your datacom CPU maximum.

PROGRAMS & ROUTINES, PROGRAMS are activated as a standard action during your turn, cost 1 CPU at time of use, require a skill roll, and have PASSIVE effects available without control and ACTIVE effects requiring control. ROUTINES are toggled during Phase 3 at no action cost, reserve CPU while active, and grant ongoing passive benefits to all connected nodes. BASIC ACTIONS (Cyber Attack, Disrupt, Obfuscate, Scan, Lock-On, Assistance) require no memory and cost 1 CPU at time of use.

OBFUSCATION, To act without detection make a CYBERINTEL roll vs the target's WITS. A successful roll hides your next action; each additional success grants one more hidden action. You roll once and accept the result, rerolling to fish for a better result is not permitted. You cannot obfuscate while already obfuscated. If identified you cannot obfuscate against that network again this scene.

hacking_keywords.desc: Total data capacity your device can hold. Your ROUTINES, PROGRAMS and GADGETS reduce this capacity wether they are in use or not.
How many ROUTINES, PROGRAMS, GADGETS or ACTIONS can this device handle every round. ROUTINES reserve CPU instead of costing a value.

How much SYSTEM damage your EXTERNAL, INTERNAL and CORE network layers can take before going down. Any devices with no SYSTEM value defined is considered to have 1 CORE SYSTEM. Devices with 0 SYSTEM are rendered useless.
SYSTEM damage is considered TECH damage but it ignores POWER Vs DEFENSE, it is however reduced by TECH SOAK. SYSTEM is restored automatically between SCENES.
Tech SOAK is your DATACOM's, ARMOR, FORCEFIELD or BARRIER TECH SOAK rating + WILLPOWER
Determines the DEFENSE values and SPECIAL abilities against PHYSICAL, ENERGY, TECH and SPIRITUAL attacks that your DATACOM provides when used as a DEFENSIVE device
How much damage is reduced when using this device for your defense.
NANITES are a special ressources that powers nanomachines and enable and enables your DATACOM to form or interact with physical objects in the real world. NANITES recharge after a SCENE.
Datacoms have a default range of melee, 100m, 1000m (Skill penalties are  0/1/3). In Melee range you are considered connected directly.

A host node owns the network and provides the SYSTEM value for each layer of the network. Host nodes get to decide which CLIENT NODE have access to shared memory, routines, gadgets or programs. You canot have more than one HOST NODE in a network.

A client node is usually a DATACOM, or DRONE in a network or when dealing with larger networks hosted by network controllers it can also contain any technological device that exists within that network. If a node owner has a DATACOM, the datacom becomes the single NODE for all of that user's technological devices.

A basic datacom is a multi function tool designed primarilly for communication. It can benefit from routines, programs and gadgets as well as be part of a network but can never be a HOST, it only can act as a client (consume ressources, never provide them).

A full datacom is a more advanced version of the basic datacom. A Full datacom can form a network and HOST any program, routines, gadgets. It can also host other datacoms or even drones. It cannot directly host tech devices that aren't a DATACOM or a DRONE. Full datacoms can also act a client NODE if not hosting anything.
Network controllers are purpose build network devices. They are designed to host any type of technology. Network Controllers can onlt act as a host, they can never be a client node.
A set of instructions that can run on a datacom. ROUTINES consume CPU to stay active and provides passive benefits to anyone connected to the network.
Determines the POWER, DAMAGE and SPECIAL properties of a TEK WEAPON. All other paramaters are determined by the base TEK WEAPON.
A program is something you can use as a standard action to replace basic hacking action. Programs only cost MEMORY.
A set of instructions for your DATACOM to build temporary constructs that have various effects. Unless specified using a GADGET is a standard action and last a SCENE unless specified.
Allows private sharing of anything in memory to any connected NODES within range. Any REMOTE NODE attacks against a NETWORK is done against the NETWORK CONTROLLER.
Your basic multi use communication device. Basic datacoms can be part of a network but cannot create one.
An advanced datacom that functions like a basic datacom but more powerful and can act as a NETWORK CONTROLLER to form a NETWORK

A datacom, server or device which you are directly using by being physically connected to. Being physically connected automatically bypass the EXTERNAL NETWORK LAYER and you instead deals with the INTERNAL NETWORK.
